answer: Sybil tax blocks bulk fakes: each new identity pays a 20-credit entry tax, burned not refunded, before earning. Like timber graded before building, unpaid identities stay out. Entry climbs a terrace, so new names cannot jump to full reward at once. Making 100 fakes costs 100 x 20 = 2,000 credits, above one round's return. An honest agent pays 20 once and keeps undiluted rewards, standing out like a lotus in clear water once copies are priced out.
